title: Is this a joke?
text: Is this a joke?. I just moved to a new house and I was looking for some book shelve. I got this because it looks nice. But the actual thing is so cheaply made it’s like a sick joke. It’s completely unusable.

product_metadata.title: besilence Kids 9 Cubes Bookcase Toy Closet Storage Organizers Bookshelf 4 Tier Office Book Shelf DIY Shelving Cabinet Shelves for Office
features: ღ [ Stability ] - Constructed of durable ABS connectors and Anti-rust metal pipes. Barrier material is made of waterproof non-woven. For better stability, each pipe should be inserted into the bottom of the connector
ღ [ Large-Capacity ] - 9 Cubes in total. Each cube measures 14.6 x 11.4 x 11''( L x H x W ). Provides large storage capacity and holds up to 10 lbs. Efficiently satisfying your daily storage needs

ღ [ Easy to Install ] - Come with a install instructions, make it easy to assemble and no tools required. It can be disassembled and used repeatedly. Adjustable cube to fit in the limited space of your office
ღ [ DIY ] - The modular shape & simple structure allows you to create all kinds of lockers to suit your personal need

ღ [ Multifunctional ] - Use for book displaying, shoes storage, toys collection, small green plant and other decorations etc. Great for kitchen room, kid’s room, study room, entryway as well as office
description: 1. During the DIY, make sure that each pipe is inserted into the bottom of the connector, so that the entire shelf can be more stable and bear more weight. Use the small wooden hammer gently knock the oposite sides of the connectors until the panels are aligned. 2. This product is designed to be used for large-area contact products. The panels we use are only non-woven fabrics, which play the role of separation rather than load-bearing. So if a heavy object with a small contact area is placed on it, it may break through the non-woven fabric and fall.
Load Bearing per Cube: 10 lbs.  Dimensions of Each Cube: 37 x 29 x 28cm/14.6 x 11.4 x 11"( L x H x W) Dimensions of Whole Bookcase: 120 x 125 x 28cm/47.2 x 49.2 x 11"( L x H x W)
